Lower Text: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When this Digimon suspends, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon with as much or less DP as it.
Upper Text: [When Digivolving] If you have 3 or more security cards, suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon or Tamers. If you have 3 or fewer, 1 of their Digimon or Tamers can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.
